text:
You need one connected web presence for CPR, daycare, and notary services, plus outreach support that can track results and stay organized across schools, banks, and other organizations.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I build clean, practical websites and systems that help service businesses present multiple offerings clearly without forcing them into separate sites. With 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I can create a landing-page style structure that ties your businesses together and supports marketing follow-up.

Recent work includes a headless storefront for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow shop and improved largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s. I also modernized a charity donor system for Oakfield Charities, cutting donation entry time by 45% with zero data loss across 180k records.

I’m happy to help with website design, outreach tracking, contact list creation, and a professional communication flow.
